name: Crates the Grammarian
bio: Crates the Grammarian is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors dates the poet to the 2nd century BC. Paton distinguishes this Crates, the grammarian, from Crates the philosopher.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 218.

poems.title: Book XI, 218
poems.author: Crates the Grammarian
poems.text: Choerilus is far inferior to Antimachus, but on all occasions Euphorion would ever talk of Choerilus and made his poems full of glosses, and knew those of Philetas well, for he was indeed a follower of Homer.
